items.title: 14.15.1 Laws and regulations (qanoon aur qaide) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.15.1, printed page 318.

blocks.text: Pakistan mein air pollution control karne ke aam laws (qanoon) aur regulations (qaide) yeh hain:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein 'Natural Environmental Quality Standard' chhapa hai. Sahi naam National Environmental Quality Standards (NEQS) hai; yeh PEPA 1997 ke under set ki gayi national limits (hadein) hain.

blocks.caption: Pakistan ke laws aur regulations
rows: PEPA ke under emission aur air quality ki limits

blocks.prompt: Pakistan mein air quality se jure laws aur regulations ke naam batayein.
blocks.explanation: Pakistan Environmental Protection Act 1997 (PEPA), us ke under National Environmental Quality Standards (NEQS) jo emission aur air quality ki limits set karte hain, aur Punjab Environmental Protection (Amendment) Act 2012.

items: PEPA 1997; NEQS; Punjab Environmental Protection (Amendment) Act 2012.
